digest.component_or_area: LLM capabilities and model overrides (Bedrock and Anthropic)
propositions: The _MODEL_ID_CAPABILITY_OVERRIDES table contains only us.anthropic.claude-opus-4-7 but does not cover claude-opus-4-8 (rebar's DEFAULT_MODEL), leaving it unguarded when temperature is configured, causing 400 ValidationException responses.

Temperature and top_p parameters are deprecated (rejected with 400 error) across the entire opus model line (opus-4-8, opus-4-7) for both us.anthropic and global.anthropic profile prefixes, but the override table only keys the us.anthropic.claude-opus-4-7 variant.

On the direct Anthropic path (not Bedrock), pydantic-ai silently drops temperature for claude-opus-4-8 per models/anthropic.py:641, emitting a warning but masking the fact that determinism (temperature=0) is not actually being enforced in Pass-2 code review verification.

The override table must be extended to cover both bare model ids (claude-opus-4-8, claude-opus-4-7) and all profile prefixes (us.anthropic.*, global.anthropic.*) to prevent capability mismatches across both Bedrock and Anthropic adapter paths.

Withdrawing temperature for opus models by setting supports_temperature=False is wire-identical to the existing pydantic-ai drop behavior but removes false assumptions about greedy decoding enforcement in greedy Pass-2 verification steps.
